notes: 100 controlled prompts for short video generation and 4D-consistency evaluation. Every prompt specifies a single continuous photorealistic shot with no cuts, a target duration, a visually identifiable foreground protagonist, a feasible action sequence, a defined camera behavior, and an explicit persistence condition. Consistency focuses use a shared twelve-label taxonomy: subject_identity, articulated_motion, rigid_geometry, attached_object, occlusion_reappearance, camera_motion, viewpoint_change, depth_consistency, surface_contact, lighting_consistency, reflection_consistency, and environment_consistency.

prompts.prompt: Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A young woman with short black hair, a bright red coat, and black boots strides left to right across a rain-slick city street and turns her head once toward the camera. A waist-high camera tracks beside her. Her face, coat, and proportions remain unchanged; neon reflections move consistently across the pavement.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A cyclist in a yellow helmet and blue jacket on a silver bicycle rides toward the camera through a cobblestone lane, then follows one left bend. The camera retreats at matching speed with the full bicycle visible. Rider, frame, and wheels retain their shape while the stone facades show stable parallax.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A compact white delivery robot with six black wheels and a blue lid rolls along a sidewalk and turns right around one building corner. The camera arcs from its front-left to rear-left side. Its body, six wheels, and lid remain unchanged, with coherent reflections in the glass storefronts.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A man in a tan trench coat carrying an open black umbrella walks beneath an elevated railway and crosses once from daylight into deep shadow. A waist-high camera follows two meters behind. The same man and umbrella remain recognizable, with colors changing only according to the lighting.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A skateboarder in a green hoodie, beige trousers, and white shoes completes one left-to-right carve across a concrete plaza. A low camera follows one meter behind. The rider, board, and four wheels remain unchanged, and both feet maintain believable contact.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A yellow four-door taxi with a black roof sign enters a downtown intersection from the left and completes one right turn. A stationary street-level camera pans right to keep it centered. Its body, doors, wheels, and sign retain identical geometry as reflections slide coherently across its windows.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A runner in an orange top, black shorts, and white shoes approaches along a riverside promenade, passes the camera on its left, and continues away. The camera pivots once to follow from behind. The runner's appearance and gait remain unchanged through frontal, side, and rear views; background depth remains stable.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A black-and-white border collie wearing a red collar trots along a pedestrian street and passes behind one metal bollard. The camera tracks parallel at the dog's eye level. The dog reappears with the same markings, collar, shape, and gait while the cafe facades remain stable.

The camera tracks parallel from her left at a fixed distance. Her face, clothing, scooter geometry, and hand and foot positions remain consistent while the same mural details persist.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A hiker in a bright blue jacket, gray backpack, and red boots takes three uphill steps over a rocky alpine trail. The camera follows closely from behind at hip height. Hiker and backpack retain their shape, each boot contacts the stones, and the distant valley preserves stable depth.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A brown deer with a white tail and small symmetrical antlers makes two bounds left to right across a forest clearing, briefly passing behind one tree trunk. A fixed camera pans right. The deer reappears with the same antlers, markings, proportions, and gait; the tree layout stays fixed.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A mountain biker in a red helmet and green jersey on a black bicycle descends toward the camera, rolls over one small bump, and passes on the right. The camera pivots once to follow. Rider, bicycle, and wheels remain unchanged, with tire contact maintained except for a brief lift over the bump.

A fixed camera keeps it full-body. Its markings, face, tail, and proportions remain identical from profile to three-quarter view; distant peaks remain stable.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A trail runner in a yellow vest, black leggings, and blue backpack runs away from the camera across a narrow wooden footbridge. The camera advances directly behind at fixed height. The runner's appearance and gait remain unchanged while the bridge rails converge consistently toward the far end.

The camera makes a shallow counterclockwise arc. Its markings, mane, limbs, and proportions remain unchanged, with a coherent reflection in the calm water.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A large brown bear with a lighter muzzle takes four steps left to right through a shallow clear stream. The camera tracks parallel from the bank. Its face, fur pattern, volume, and gait remain unchanged; each paw displaces water at contact while submerged stones stay fixed.

Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A worker in a yellow helmet, orange vest, and gray trousers walks along a metal catwalk and descends exactly three stairs. Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. Photorealistic, single continuous shot, no cuts. A cyclist in a white helmet and teal jacket on a red bicycle rides around one bench and crosses from warm lamplight into cool ambient light.
